title: Evidence disposition
required_prerequisites: Operator review observations generated through the active local read-only route
Where applicable, bounded RO4-G4 append-only boundary, friction, review or concentration acknowledgement records
Sufficient reproducible evidence to support one consolidated operator-required disposition decision
why_not_authorised: RO4-G6 is an operator-required evidence-disposition gate. Route activation and synthetic assurance tests do not constitute collected market or operator-review evidence and cannot support a disposition decision.
smallest_lawful_resolution: Use the active local read-only C2 sequence-evidence route on admissible projections, collect reproducible operator review and permitted append-only records, inventory and QA that evidence, then prepare one consolidated RO4-G6 operator gate packet.
rollback: No rollback is required for this blocker. Preserve the active read-only route and all historical evidence; disable the route only through a separate non-destructive rollback decision if a defect is found.
